tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind surfaces. Light value is the Ink Slate tint.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs, nav bars.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, code blocks, track of progress bars, hover rows.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus, toasts — anything floating above surface. Dark value is Ink Slate.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines only — never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, checkboxes, outline buttons). 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Ink Slate — primary text and headers on bg, surface, surface-sunken, surface-raised, and on every -soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, meta, table cells. AA on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Placeholders, captions, hints. Still AA 4.5:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Ink Slate — dark sidebars, app bars and hero panels. Text on it uses on-sidebar.

tokens.name: on-sidebar
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sidebar.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Ocean Azure — main buttons, active states, selected nav, progress fill, brand highlights.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Ocean Azure tint — selected rows, active tab pill, nav pip.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Links and azure text on surfaces and on primary-soft. (#0077B6 itself is 4.47:1 on bg, so text uses this shade.)

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Deep Teal — charts, icons, tag outlines, decorative fills. 3:1 on surfaces; not for small text, and white text on it is only 4.08:1.

tokens.name: secondary-strong
tokens.usage: Teal fill behind white text: solid secondary buttons. 4.6:1 with on-secondary.

tokens.name: secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of secondary-strong.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary-strong.

tokens.name: secondary-soft
tokens.usage: Deep Teal tint — tonal secondary buttons, tags, info banners.

tokens.name: secondary-text
tokens.usage: Teal text on surfaces and on secondary-soft.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Magenta Rose — notification badges, counts, call-to-action highlights. White text on it is exactly 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Magenta Rose tint — featured cards, highlight banners.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Magenta text on surfaces and on accent-soft.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on surfaces and success-soft. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success banner and badge background.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on surfaces and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning banner and badge background.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, destructive buttons, invalid field borders. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error banner and badge background.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (destructive button).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info text and icons — Deep Teal, same as secondary-text.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info banner and badge background — Deep Teal tint.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1 on bg, surface, surface-sunken and surface-raised.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and sheets.

families.display: "Bricolage Grotesque", "Noto Sans Tamil", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans: Lato, "Noto Sans Tamil", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per screen at most: onboarding, hero, big numbers.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Screen titles on large layouts; stat values.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Set a destination and sleep — we'll wake you 2 km before.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs, kids' content, and Tamil-heavy screens.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Water the seedlings early, before 9 am.
styles.usage: Default text. Never smaller for running copy.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary text, help text under fields, table cells.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, button text, tab labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Smallest allowed size: badges, timestamps, overlines. Never for sentences.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: No gap.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip gaps, input inner gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; list item vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gutter: card padding on phones, page side padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on tablet+, form field stack gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and between groups in a form.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space above a section heading.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large section breaks.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero and page-level breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Focus-ring corners on text links, tiny tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, small buttons, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, list rows, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and banners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets, hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, switches, segmented tabs, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards that sit on bg.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus, toasts, sticky bars.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheets.

size.note: Control heights, touch targets and icon sizes.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact control height (desktop-only toolbars). Still above the WCAG 2.5.8 24px minimum.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Default control height: buttons, inputs, selects. Meets the 44px touch target.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary call-to-action on phones.

tokens.name: size-target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for any tappable thing, including icon buttons.

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside badges and dense rows.

tokens.name: size-icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size in buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: Nav bar and standalone icons.

tokens.name: size-measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for running text.

border.note: Stroke widths. Pair with line, line-strong or focus.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines (with line).

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and outline button borders (with line-strong).

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus-ring width; offset by the same amount.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Switches, tabs, small reveals.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Sheets and dialogs entering.
